I came across this dataset published by the Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) and thought it might make make a nice interactive chart for exploration and comparison.

There are filters for country, region and chamber type; you can also narrow date range by selecting in chart.

(Uses plotly, reactable and crosstalk.)
